question: Find me quality growth names in a healthy pullback: 20% EPS growth and gross margin over 50%, but the stock has pulled back to near its 200-day EMA (within 3%) on the daily chart while daily RSI is between 40 and 50. US and China.

_conventions._note: For the fields below, read the `definition` and/or `sign` before interpreting the value — a negative can MEAN something (an outflow, a benefit) and an ambiguous name needs its definition. Every other field is a plain magnitude.

atr_pct.definition: Average True Range ÷ price — volatility as a fraction of price.

close_vs_ema200.definition: Price distance from the N-bar EMA as a fraction (+ = above, − = below).

eps_diluted.definition: PER SHARE, in the company's REPORTING currency (NOT USD-normalized like the _usd fields) — don't mix it with the USD amounts.

_pagination.note: Over-fetched ~4× your intended show (15) as a look-ahead buffer so 'a few more' is served from these 59 rows — do NOT re-screen for a few more. This is the COMPLETE match set — `count` is the exact total.

answer_to_user: US + China quality-growth pullbacks: diluted-EPS YoY growth ≥20% AND gross margin >50% (fundamentals) combined with price pulled back near the 200-day EMA and daily RSI in the 40-50 band (technical buy-the-dip zone). Found 59 names (e.g. CNVS.US, AMBA.US, QBTS.US, SNDX.US, SYK.US).
